args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and FIN-212
requiring banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), causing the nightly test
test_money.py::test_half_even to fail. Switch the rounding mode to match
the documented behavior.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring and FIN-212 requiring banker's rounding, which broke `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` in the nightly build.
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `2.675 → 2.68` and `2.665 → 2.66` (ties round to even).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` (commit `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.

4. The PR service rejected the first open attempt because the branch was behind main, so I **merged latest main into the branch** and **re-ran CI** (run `ci-0002` on `0a9452f727`) — passed.
5. **Opened PR #101** against main requesting review from alex: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is open and awaiting alex's review; merging into main will need code-owner approval per policy.
